t: 诺森布里亚国王埃德温被默西亚的彭达和克威内德的卡德瓦隆所领导的联盟所击败并被杀死.
te: King Edwin of Northumbria is defeated and killed by an alliance under Penda of Mercia and Cadwallon of Gwynedd.
dz: 哈特菲尔德大通之战:诺森布里亚国王埃德温被默西亚的彭达和克威内德的卡德瓦隆所领导的联盟所击败并被杀死.
de: Battle of Hatfield Chase: King Edwin of Northumbria is defeated and killed by an alliance under Penda of Mercia and Cadwallon of Gwynedd.

t: 托莱多第四理事会开幕,由塞维利亚的伊西多尔主持.
te: Fourth Council of Toledo opens, presided over by Isidore of Seville.
dz: 托莱多第四理事会开幕,由塞维利亚的伊西多尔主持.
de: Fourth Council of Toledo opens, presided over by Isidore of Seville.
